note: Hand-picked from verified flows and chain reads; not reviewed by a human expert.

items.text: Six wallets received 497,971 ETH through the traced flows and still hold it, nearly all the ETH on the Dormant card: 0x8532…43d4 197,460; 0xc887…286a 137,602; 0x897c…8df3 78,415; 0x79e7…544a 34,280; 0x5440…c942 32,954; 0x03b0…20ea 17,260. 0x8532 and 0x03b0 got theirs straight from the attacker's main wallet 0x5227…2f8c, the other four through other traced wallets. All six first appear between 29 Oct 20:38 and 30 Oct 05:14 UTC, and none had sent a transaction at block 26,316,697.
items.note: The reports checked on 31 Oct give the attacker's ETH as a total only (Elliptic: 519,104 ETH; TRM: more than 420,000 ETH).

items.text: The attacker's wallets were still selling stolen tokens for ETH on 31 Oct: 168 swaps that day (FUN, ZAMA, LSK and others) brought 5,766 ETH, the latest at 20:01 UTC from 0x2274…64b0. The proceeds went on to 0x8d4b…9e19: 1,017.56 ETH from 0x2274 at 20:02 and 861.48 ETH from 0xc586…e935 at 21:01. 0x8d4b holds 9,788 ETH and had sent no transaction at block 26,316,735. Since the theft, 25 wallets have sold 51 tokens in 1,039 swaps for 257,843 ETH.
items.note: Swaps counted from the verified flows on this page; the 20:02 transfer and the balance read on chain at block 26,316,735.

items.text: The 18,270.2 BTC on the Dormant card sit in 19 wallets: 17 hold 1,000 BTC each, the other two 832.5 and 437.7. bc1q0mtc…2mnm, the address the theft paid, split it into them on 29 Oct in blocks 973,732 and 973,738 (20:20 and 20:48 UTC). None had moved at Bitcoin block 973,999.
items.note: CoinDesk reported the split on 30 Oct.

items.text: On 29 Oct at 23:27 UTC, 58,397,344 SAND left the attacker's main wallet 0x5227…2f8c for 0x84a9…d87d in one transaction executed by SAND's admin, the Safe 0x6ec4…60a1 (getAdmin() on the SAND contract): it made itself a super-operator, moved the tokens and gave the right up. The Frozen card counts them as taken back, about $2.75M.
items.note: Not in the reports checked on 31 Oct (TRM, Elliptic, Chainalysis).

items.text: 0x79e7…544a holds 34,280 ETH. 25,611 ETH of it came from two wallets that 0x5227…2f8c gave tokens and gas: 0x600d…8298 sold 7.68T PEPE on Uniswap and sent 14,050 ETH; 0xcf4c…23e0 sold 2.57M LINK and sent 11,561 ETH. The 19,740 ETH a 30 Oct report lists here is the balance before 05:27 UTC that day, before the LINK proceeds arrived.
items.note: Not in the reports checked on 31 Oct.

items.text: Between 21:31 and 22:22 UTC on 29 Oct, two wallets funded by 0x5227…2f8c sent ETH into bridges: 0x3e2b…32d5 sent 0.486 ETH and 0x0e77…77d3 0.5 ETH into MetaBridge, and 0x0e77 another 0.2 ETH into LI.FI. Where they went on the other chains is not traced yet.
